findings.problem: Earlier C working tokens cannot read later refined working tokens under the old triangular mask.

findings.problem: The old generator-use preference can improve by increasing wrong-condition error alone.
findings.change: Train one correct-condition generator branch with FM/process; independent native-T5 dropout preserves the complete request in C.

findings.problem: Conditional verifier interactions can still read static video feature offsets despite additive-bias cancellation.
findings.change: Read observed feature changes relative to the first endpoint and subtract the zero-response value at matching times.
findings.scope: Invariant only to temporally constant additive feature offsets, not all appearance transformations; static RGB can still have temporally varying context features.
